changelog: - **A Converter set to pull all no longer stops when its amounts are very small.** In a group of Converters and Gates that the engine plans together, a pull-all Converter checks that it received everything a run needs. That check read the amounts the way they are shown, and an amount of 0.000000001 or less is shown as nothing, so in a model whose amounts are that small (for example every amount scaled down by 10^10) the Converter read "nothing arrived" and stopped, and the group with it, although the amounts had arrived. It now reads what actually arrived. A Converter that is really short still stops. Models at ordinary sizes and the bundled examples run as before. A Monte Carlo result saved before this change is shown as stale until it is run again (engine revision 20).
